3-Piece sofa with loveseat and storage ottoman (Gray)
Sofa set includes: 1 x 3-seat sofa, 1 x chaise lounge, 1 x ottoman, 6 x pillows
Upholstered in soft microfiber and faux linen cushions padded with thick foam for an elegant appearance and extra comfort
Material: microfiber and faux linen ; Legs: Plastic leg ， wooden frame
The back cushion of the sofa is filled with sponge, which is soft and has better resilience.

Package Includes:
1 set of sofa in 3 cartons
Assembly Hardware
Assembly Tool
Assembly Manual

Set Includes
1* Modular Sofa
(no other presentation items included).

Notice:
1. Due to manual measurement, please allow 2-3% error, before you bid, please make sure you don't mind.
2. The color may vary due to different displays, please refer to the actual product.
High elasticity sponge pads and fluffy back cushions support your shoulders, hips, and waist, helping to relieve spinal pressure.
